title: •Dead Ewok
caption: •Dead Ewok (V)
game_text: Cancel Ellorrs Madak. {sense} OR Use 2 Force to cancel the game text of an opponent’s alien for remainder of turn. OR Place an Ewok Catapult in opponent’s Used Pile. OR Make an Ewok power and forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn.
lore: Many Ewoks gave their lives in the Battle of Endor.

notes: Unique. Banner LOST INTERRUPT (printed base is also a Lost Interrupt). Red circle-slash S after 'Cancel Ellorrs Madak.' → {sense} (immunity applies to the first option; stub reads 'Immune to Sense.'). Curly apostrophes in opponent’s (twice). Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright line not legible on the 350 px scan; set-convention form. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3-D-deadewok-pre.gif, 350 px; non-pre VB3 also exists).
